$comment: Example manifest for a fictional company. Exercises every field the renderer reads, so it doubles as the test fixture. Copy this shape for your own engines.json — the paths in `dir` are relative to `root` in your config.

engines.name: Signal
engines.role: Collects source material, deduplicates it, and ranks what is worth acting on. Produces a ranked shortlist and nothing else — deciding what to build with it belongs to Forge.
ingress: Public RSS and API feeds (28 sources)

nodes.name: collect
nodes.desc: Fetches every source in parallel, with a per-source timeout so one slow feed cannot stall a run.

nodes.name: dedupe
nodes.desc: Near-duplicate detection across the current window and the previous shortlist.

nodes.name: rank
nodes.desc: Deterministic scoring. Ordering is never delegated to a model — the weights are in the repo and reviewable.

scriptNotes.rank: weights live in config/weights.json — change those, not the script

engines.name: Forge
engines.role: Turns an approved shortlist item into a finished artefact. Owns every output gate, so nothing leaves the building without passing them.
ingress: Brand tokens from the design package
egress: Built artefacts with a provenance record
A published changelog entry per release

nodes.name: build
nodes.desc: Compiles an artefact from an approved item. Fails closed if provenance is missing.

nodes.name: gates
nodes.desc: Runs the full output gate suite: schema, links, accessibility, and size budget.

nodes.name: release
nodes.desc: Publishes a passing artefact and records the release. The only step that writes outside the repo.

engines.name: Atlas
engines.role: The shared index every other project reads from. Session-driven: there is no pipeline, you query it.
ingress: Artefacts and provenance records from Forge
engines.dashboardNote: Atlas ships its own status page; this generator writes only its command sheet.

engines.name: Sketch
engines.role: Illustration and layout work. Deliberately has no package.json — a project can be part of the company without being a node project, and the dashboard should say nothing rather than invent a command surface.

satellites.name: design tokens
satellites.note: Single source of truth for brand colours and spacing
